body:
Design the empty state of the consent manager screen for **Mifos X Open Banking**, a professional open banking KMP super-app for consumer retail banking and field officer agent banking powered by Open Bank Project API v7.

Palette: primary #B2D188, on_primary #1F3701, primary_container #354E16, secondary #A0CFCB, error #FFB4AB, background #12140E, on_surface #E3E3D8, on_surface_variant #C5C8BA, surface_container #1E201A, surface_container_high #282A24, outline #8F9285, outline_variant #44483D, pending #E8A317.

**Component 1 — App Bar** (64dp tall, full width): Title "Connected Apps" Outfit Medium 18sp #E3E3D8, leading back-arrow 24dp #B2D188, background #12140E.

**Component 2 — Hero** (centered, top margin 80dp): 120dp wide illustration of a disconnected link icon rendered in #44483D on #12140E background, conveying no connected apps without alarming tones.

**Component 3 — List Row** (centered text block, top margin 24dp, horizontal padding 48dp): Title "No apps connected" Outfit SemiBold 20sp #E3E3D8 centered max 2 lines. Subtitle "Third-party apps you authorise will appear here. Visit your bank's app marketplace to connect." Outfit Regular 14sp #C5C8BA centered line-height 20sp. empty_state archetype.

**Component 4 — Button** (full width minus 64dp insets, top margin 32dp): Filled button 48dp tall, 24dp corner radius, background #B2D188, label "Explore App Marketplace" Outfit SemiBold 15sp #1F3701 centered.

Do not use em-dash anywhere in text. Do not make any headline more than 3 lines or any subtitle more than 25 words. Do not break the dark page theme between sections. Do not place light text on light buttons or dark text on dark buttons.

Centered layout on #12140E with generous vertical breathing room. The sage-green #B2D188 on the primary CTA maintains brand warmth even in absence states, inviting the user forward with calm financial confidence.
